title: An EXPR parameter is evaluated in the filter context of the function body
query: DEFINE FUNCTION ComputeForRed = ( amountExpr : EXPR ) => CALCULATE ( amountExpr, Product[Color] = "Red" )

source.quote: Changing the parameter-passing mode to EXPR makes the function work smoothly
source.supports: the article gives this function as the working version

source.quote: Expression parameters are passed as formulas, and they are evaluated every time the function uses them.
source.supports: an EXPR parameter is evaluated where the function body uses it

derivation: amountExpr is EXPR: [Sales Amount] is evaluated where the body uses it, inside CALCULATE with Color = Red: rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 100 + 40 + 20 + 200 + 100 = 460.
